name: Izumi Toya
source:
He originally gained popularity as a vocalist active on the internet.
Using the profits from that success, he founded a talent production company and began producing female idols while continuing his own activities.
He has already debuted several idol groups, and despite his young age, he's building a reputation within the industry as a highly skilled producer.
However, even during his time as a vocalist, he was infamous for getting involved with his fans.
He lets girls he takes a liking to live in his home, seduces them with his smooth, experienced ways, and then toys with them. He employs his ex-girlfriends and casual flings at his company.
